diff:
Field `identificationModule.briefTitle` changed from `Study of Efficacy and Safety of CRC01 in Adult Large B-cell Lymphoma Patients` to `Study of Efficacy and Safety of CRC01 in Adult Large B-cell Lymphoma and B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Patients`
Field `identificationModule.officialTitle` changed from `An Open-label, Multi-center, Single-arm Phase 1/2 Study to Assess Tolerability, Safety and Efficacy of CRC01 in Adult Patients With Relapsed or Refractory Large B-cell Lymphoma` to `An Open-label, Multi-center, Single-arm Phase 1/2 Study to Assess Tolerability, Safety and Efficacy of CRC01 in Adult Patients With Relapsed or Refractory Large B-cell Lymphoma and B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia`
Field `statusModule.statusVerifiedDate` changed from `2021-04` to `2026-06`
Field `statusModule.primaryCompletionDateStruct.date` changed from `2023-05` to `2030-08-15`
Field `statusModule.completionDateStruct.date` changed from `2028-02` to `2030-09-26`
Field `statusModule.lastUpdateSubmitDate` changed from `2021-04-29` to `2026-06-29`
Field `statusModule.lastUpdatePostDateStruct.date` changed from `2021-05-03` to `2026-07-01`
Field `descriptionModule.briefSummary` changed from `This is a multi-center, phase I/II study to determine the efficacy and safety of CRC01 in adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma.` to `This is a multi-center, phase I/II study to determine the efficacy and safety of CRC01 in adult patients with relapsed or refractory large B-cell lymphoma and B-cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia.`
Field `armsInterventionsModule.interventions.[0]description` changed from `A single infusion of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-transduced autologous T cells administered intravenously at a target dose of 2 x 10\^6 anti-CD19 CAR T cells/kg.` to `Cohort A :A single infusion of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-transduced autologous T cells administered intravenously at a target dose of 2 x 10\^6 anti-CD19 CAR T cells/kg.

Cohort B :A single infusion of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR)-transduced autologous T cells administered intravenously at a target dose of 1.5 x 10\^6 anti-CD19 CAR T cells/kg.`
Field `outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes.[1]measure` changed from `Phase 2 Pivotal Study: Overall Response Rate (ORR)` to `Phase 2 Pivotal Study: Cohort A : Overall Response Rate (ORR) Cohort B : Overall Complete Remission Rate (OCR)`
Field `outcomesModule.primaryOutcomes.[1]description` changed from `ORR is defined as the incidence of either a complete response (CR) or a partial response (PR) per the Lugano Criteria for Response Assessment (2014).` to `Cohort A : ORR is defined as the incidence of either a complete response (CR) or a partial response (PR) per the Lugano Criteria for Response Assessment (2014).

Cohort B : OCR is defined as the incidence of either a complete Remission (CR) or a Complete Remission with incomplete hematologic recovery (CRi) per the ALL Response Criteria.`
Field `eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria` changed from `Inclusion Criteria:

1. ≥ 19 years of age and provided written informed consent
2. Histologically confirmed following large B-cell lymphomas according to the World Health Organization classification 2017

   * Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified Including Large cell transformation from follicular lymphoma (Transformed follicular lymphoma)
   * High-grade B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified
   * High-grade B-cell lymphoma with double-hit/triple-hit
   * Primary mediastinal large B cell lymphoma
3. Relapsed or refractory disease after ≥ two lines of chemotherapy including rituximab, anthracycline and either having failed autologous Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (ASCT) or being ineligible for or not consenting to ASCT.
4. At least one measurable lesion (Long diameter ≥ 1.5cm)
5. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1
6. Adequate renal and hepatic functions based on the laboratory test results

   * Total Bilirubin ≤ 2.0mg/dL w` to `Cohort A:

Inclusion Criteria:

1. ≥ 19 years of age and provided written informed consent
2. Histologically confirmed following large B-cell lymphomas according to the World Health Organization classification 2017

   * Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified Including Large cell transformation from follicular lymphoma (Transformed follicular lymphoma)
   * High-grade B-cell lymphoma, not otherwise specified
   * High-grade B-cell lymphoma with double-hit/triple-hit
   * Primary mediastinal large B cell lymphoma
3. Relapsed or refractory disease after ≥ two lines of chemotherapy including rituximab, anthracycline and either having failed autologous Hematopoietic stem cell transplantation (ASCT) or being ineligible for or not consenting to ASCT.
4. At least one measurable lesion (Long diameter ≥ 1.5cm)
5. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1
